_description:
Event appearances: the real-game source and the single-player ways of obtaining of the designs in the shop that have no source (E11 'cosmetic', E4 Holo)
-> server/data/event_appearances.json (server: event_appearances.py).

Input belgeler/wiki/tasarim_kaynaklari.json: darkorbitwiki's "OBTAINING" labels on the ship, drone and P.E.T. pages, the reward rows and box contents of the event
pages, per design ('events': the event names derived from the labels).
Only those with a shop label (SHOP PAYMENTS, HOURLY AUCTION; no event name) are not counted as event appearances, they are always in the shop. The others are
event appearances: while the panel's "Event appearances in the shop" setting is off they do not appear in the shop and cannot be sold; independent of the setting they are obtained
through the routes here:
  exchange  key exchange of an event with a Battle Pass (battle_pass.py): ship and P.E.T. design 25 keys, once; drone design
            15 keys, 10 times (wiki: Galactic Strife 2026's exchange)
  box       keyed loot box (loot.py; boxes.json type; an owned design is not drawn). The route of a design already in the box's wiki table (Epic packages
            included) is "table": true (no extra row is added); Red Box's designs also go into Blue Box. These routes are "local" rows outside the
            wiki table that take part in the box's design draw (loot.pick). The top-level key "box_extra": 15 old P.E.T. designs from the current
            Red / Blue page (2026-10-25) that have no other way of being obtained (so they are not left without a route)
  gate      the choice reward of the Zeta and Kappa gates on GG Special Rewards Weekend (wiki: Delta, Epsilon, Zeta, Kappa; 50%, an owned one
            is not drawn)
  map       the event's map box (event_maps.py): Goal Rush's football box, December's gift box
  season    Season Pass season designs (season.py): the drone and P.E.T. designs of 14 seasons in season order, starting over after 2026-08
Event selection: the events in the wiki labels (under their name on the server); for those without a label or only "BOXES" / "–"
the design's theme (the event of labeled designs of the same theme: Arios and Neikos Galactic Strife, Dusklight and Phantasm Trial of
Terrors, Inferno Protegit, Epion / Osiris / Smite triples GG weekend gates …), and if that is missing too, the theme's general box: ship Obsidian,
drone Apocalypse, P.E.T. Red Box (the Argon, Lava, Legend, Carbonite, Sandstorm … designs are in these boxes).
Past events that have no wiki page and ran once go to the nearest event (adaptation): Battle Arena -> Galactic Strife (ranking
reward), Plague Mutation -> Prosperous Mutation, Astral Discovery -> Empyrian March (the design there too), Blacklight Surge's Tyrannos to
Mimesis Mutiny; SpaceCup's to its successor Goal Rush; with Saimon Rebellion, Project Nano, Razer week, special quest themes.
Generated by: tools/event_appearances.py.
